evidence.observation: Monotonic rise through growth from 13.5 to 54.5 ppm, far above the ~5-8 ppm floor reached at end of purge
Temperature holds 750 °C at setpoint, heater power and Ar flow steady and nominal, so the drift is atmosphere-specific not thermal or flow control
Pressure gauge not installed; tube atmosphere cannot be independently verified

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) to distinguish air ingress from exhaust restriction; an Ar flow step (e.g., 100 → 300 sccm) would dilute a fixed leak and confirm ingress, plus post-run leak-up/seal inspection.
